name: CTET
intro: The CTET form asks for a passport-size photograph and a scanned signature, each within a KB range.

notes: Light or white background; at least 80% of your face visible with both ears. No caps or tinted glasses.
documents.label: Photograph
documents.caption: optional

notes: Black or blue ink on plain white paper, in running handwriting (not block capitals).
documents.label: Signature

source.label: Summary of CTET 2026 application requirements (coaching-site summary, check the information bulletin)

faqs.q: What is the CTET photo size?
faqs.a: 3.5 × 4.5 cm, JPG, between 10 KB and 100 KB.

faqs.q: What is the CTET signature size?
faqs.a: 3.5 × 1.5 cm, JPG, between 3 KB and 30 KB.
